receipt.public_excerpt: Claude Computer Use 3.7 and Operator achieve a high success rate of 90.4% and 83.1% on easy tasks but still struggle with harder tasks

evidence_items.explanation: Human-checked results show real web agents doing well on easy tasks and struggling on harder ones. That is short of the reliable delegated agents in question, but it says nothing about whether such agents can never exist.

unresolved_gaps: I found no independent, human-checked 2026 measurement showing agents reliably doing complex delegated web work. Aggregated 2026 leaderboard figures conflict and are partly self-reported.
'Never' cannot be confirmed by any date. Only the arrival of such agents could settle it, by showing it false.
